name: E-Way Bills Issued
description: An e-way bill is required for most movements of goods worth over ₹50,000 under GST, so monthly volumes are a near-real-time proxy for freight. September 2026 was a record month, up 7.2% from a year earlier.
releaseSchedule: Released in the first ten days of the following month.

chart.title: E-way bills hit a record in September
chart.subtitle: E-way bills generated, million, monthly
chart.source: GSTN data via Business Standard, 9 Oct 2026
